title: Excellent app highly recommended
body:
This app is awesome. Super easy to use, intuitive and effective. Highly recommended for anyone who needs to get organized. Put all your responsibilities appointments and to-do lists in one place. The app is structured in a very organized and logical way so as not to become cluttered. 
The customer service is also responsive and helpful replying on the same day 
Massive thumbs up. 👍👍👍

title: Favorite planner so far
body:
I love the habit function with all my other tasks. The view of the homepage is very satisfying and easy to navigate. The only thing about it is I wish we had more themes / colors to choose from.

Other than that, I also wish the All-in-One Widget also showed the day’s events in addition to the tasks and habits.
